item.title: OpenBSD 8.0 on a Scaleway Instance
item.description:
TL;DR:
Every few years I want to install OpenBSD at Scaleway… but they don’t support OpenBSD and I need to find a way to install regardless.

Here we go again…
#

Since early 2010, I’ve been a regular customer of Dedibox then Scaleway, particularly because they’re very geeky and also because I’ve always personally known people working there which proves helpful at times :-)

I take short consulting engagements — architecture review, technical due diligence, mail infrastructure — through aljuna.tech.
